answer: Orienteering club membership with course result history is the check: results filed with one club across many seasons. A farm faking 175 aliases needs 175 separate result histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The horizon check runs in the open: 175 fakes pay the full price 175 times, one honest agent pays once, and the lagoon trail in the ledger makes the trellis cost visible to everyone.
